name: api_client
label: API client
description: The code in a client (the app, the desktop shell) that calls one endpoint and reads its answer.

name: cli_command
label: CLI command
description: A command of the `lathe` command line that runs one command: it sits under the command it runs, and its ID is the command's with -CLI.

name: cli_query
label: CLI query
description: A command of the `lathe` command line that asks one query: it sits under the query it asks, and its ID is the query's with -CLI.

name: client_index
label: Client index
description: An index a client (the app, the desktop page) builds from a read model's answers, with what it reads beside them, to look records up without asking again: a client-side projection that renders nothing. It sits under the read model whose answers it indexes, and its ID is the read model's with -IX.

name: ipc_channel
label: IPC channel
description: How the desktop page asks the shell's main process to run one command: the desktop's endpoint, which has no method or route.

name: ipc_query
label: IPC query
description: How the desktop page asks the shell's main process one query: the desktop's endpoint for a read, under the query it asks, with no method or route.

name: plugin_hook
label: Plugin hook
description: A hook of Lathe's Claude Code plugin: code the integration's host calls on one of its events, a second piece of the integration beside its adapter.

name: shared_module
label: Shared module
description: Code several technical records use and none implements alone, such as the contrast math or the JSON file helper. It sits under the domain whose records use it, Platform when several domains do.

name: skill
label: Skill
description: A skill of Lathe's Claude Code plugin, which an Agent follows to write or check a product's spec through the MCP tools.
